library(GAPR)
library(readr)

bbc = read.csv('還原字型0.8_5的tfidf前30.csv', check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
token_names_original <- colnames(bbc)

respond = GAP(
    data = bbc,
    row.prox = 'pearson',
    col.prox = 'pearson',
    row.order = 'original',
    col.order = 'average',
    border = TRUE,
    PNGfilename = '還原字型0.8_5的tfidf前30的GAP.png',
    show.plot = TRUE,
    exp.column_order = TRUE,
    exp.col_prox = TRUE
)
class(respond$col.tree) 
colprox <- as.matrix(respond$col_prox)

# 設定輸出檔名與圖片尺寸（單位為像素）
# png("bbc_gap_heatmap3.png", width = 1200, height = 1200)
# 繪圖（請將 rowprox 換成你的矩陣變數名稱）
# heatmap(colprox, col = colorRampPalette(c("white", "yellow", "red"))(100), main = "GAP Heatmap of BBC Token Correlations")
# 關閉圖形設備，完成儲存
# dev.off()

# library(cluster) ; library(mclust)
# true_label <- bbc$category
# gap_cluster  <- cutree(hclust(as.dist(1 - rowprox)), k = 5)
# adjustedRandIndex(true_label, gap_cluster)
token_order <- respond$column_order
token_names <- token_names_original[token_order]

# 分群：可視需要切成 K 群（例：5 群）
token_cluster <- cutree(hclust(as.dist(1 - colprox)), k = 5)

if(length(token_names) == length(token_cluster)) {
  token_to_topic <- data.frame(token = token_names, topic = token_cluster)
  write.csv(token_to_topic, "還原字型0.8_5的tfidf前30的token分配主題.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("✅ 成功產生 token_to_topic.csv\n")
} else {
  cat("❌ token_names 還是空的，請檢查 GAP 前的欄名是否傳進去\n")
}

token_names <- token_names_original[token_order]
token_names

# 假設你看到第一群是第 1~12 個、第二群是 13~25 個……
token_cluster <- rep(NA, length(token_names))
token_cluster[1:20] <- 1
token_cluster[21:42] <- 2
token_cluster[43:64] <- 3
token_cluster[65:101] <- 4
token_cluster[102:123] <- 5

token_to_topic <- data.frame(token = token_names, topic = token_cluster)
write.csv(token_to_topic, "還原字型0.8_5的tfidf前30手動分群.csv", row.names = FALSE)

token_to_topic
